title: Private DR: add backup/restore dashboards (success rate, duration pctl, last-success age, restore drill annotations)
author: Sergio Costa
description: Title: Private DR: add backup/restore dashboards (success rate, duration pctl, last-success age, restore drill annotations) Summary: Adds Grafana dashboards for Redwood Private Day-2 Ops (backup/restore) to make backup health and restore drills visible to operators and SRE. This includes: (1) Backup job success rate + failure breakdown, (2) Backup duration percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and per-step timing where available, (3) "Last successful backup age" panels (time since last successful backup) for fast paging triage, (4) Restore drill annotations so game days and operator-run drills show up on the timeline alongside SLO-ish trends. Scope: This PR is dashboards-only. Alert rules for missed windows / repeated failures are tracked in PR #237. Metrics assumed: rw_private_backup_job_total{cluster,namespace,result}, rw_private_backup_job_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster,namespace}, rw_private_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster,namespace}, rw_private_restore_drill_event_total{cluster,namespace,outcome}, rw_private_restore_rto_seconds{cluster,namespace}. Notes/assumptions: - Dashboards are intended for Private deployments (VPC + on-prem). Filtering uses cluster + namespace variables; no customer identifiers. - The "age" panel intentionally uses now() - last_success_ts and shows 'No data' as a distinct state (helpful for paused clusters / newly installed). - Restore drill annotations are sourced from the rw_private_restore_drill_event_total counter with an annotation query; the drill name/id is pulled from drill_id label where present, but the panels work without it. - Runbook links: panels include a "Runbook" link placeholder to Confluence (to be wired in alerting PR); this follows our convention of using dashboard links for operators even when alerts aren’t present. Screenshots: Included in the dashboard json via panel descriptions (kept minimal) since we don’t embed images in this repo. Test plan: - `make dashboards-lint` - `make dashboards-build` - Import into staging Grafana (sre-staging) and validate variable filtering for 3 clusters - Verified drill annotations by replaying two restore drill events in metrics sandbox Related: - Linear ENG-4869 (Observability requirements—metrics, dashboards, and alerts for backup/restore) - Confluence: Eng Private Deployments > Day-2 ops > backup/restore overview (links added as placeholders) - Upcoming: PR #237 (alerts for missed backup windows + repeated failures) Checklist: [x] Dashboard JSON passes lint/build [x] Uses standard label set (cluster, namespace) [x] No PII labels [x] Added minimal README notes for operators [x] Reviewed with SRE for panel usefulness
commits: dashboards(private-dr): add Private backup overview dashboard
dashboards(private-dr): add restore drill dashboard + annotations query
docs: add short README section for Private DR dashboards
chore(ci): update dashboards-lint to validate panel links
conversation: Allison Grant (review): Love that you included last-success age. Two nits: (1) please avoid drill_name as a label if it’s user-provided (cardinality risk), and (2) duration panel currently uses avg over 5m; can we switch to histogram_quantile for p95/p99 to match our other job dashboards? Sergio Costa (author): Good call. I removed drill_name from the annotation query (only using drill_id when present, otherwise outcome) and switched the duration panels to histogram_quantile on rw_private_backup_job_duration_seconds_bucket. Also added a small note in panel description that p99 is noisy on low-volume clusters. Rafael Mendes (review): For restore drills, can we show RTO time series per drill outcome and add an annotation for "restore started" and "restore finished"? We’ve been capturing those as two increments in the sandbox. Sergio Costa (author): Added a "Restore drill timeline" row: - `restore_started_total` and `restore_finished_total` counters show up in annotations when present. For now we still support only `rw_private_restore_drill_event_total` by mapping started/finished/outcome via label `event` (if missing, we annotate only when outcome != unknown). Sean Gallagher (review): Age panel: can you clamp negatives? We sometimes see clock skew in on-prem labs and it makes the panel confusing. Also, can we make the "No data" case explicit (e.g., show 'Never succeeded' instead of empty graph)? Sergio Costa (author): Yep. Age query now wraps with `clamp_min()` and the stat panel uses a "No value" mapping to 'Never succeeded'. I also added a panel that shows the raw last_success timestamp for debugging skew. Allison Grant (follow-up): CI failed on first run due to link validation (Confluence URLs). Can we avoid hardcoding the full URL (since internal vs customer confluence differs) and keep it as a placeholder var? Sergio Costa (author): Updated panel links to use `${__dashboard.uid}` for internal navigation and a `runbook_base_url` dashboard variable defaulting to 'https://confluence.redwoodinference.com'. Lint now validates that it’s a templated link, not a hardcoded page id. Allison Grant (approval): Approved. Please merge after CI green.
ci_notes: Initial CI run failed dashboards-lint due to hardcoded Confluence page links in panel 'Runbook' URLs. Updated to templated `runbook_base_url` variable + relative paths; reran CI successfully.
release_notes:
- Added Grafana dashboards for Private backup/restore: success rate, duration percentiles, last successful backup age, and restore drill annotations.
- Added operator README for finding/importing these dashboards.
- CI dashboard lint now validates templated runbook links.
